summary: STMicroelectronics N.V. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. All resolutions were approved, including adoption of statutory annual accounts, a cash dividend of $0.36 per share payable in quarterly installments, reappointment of a Supervisory Board member, approval of stock-based compensation, and authorizations for share repurchases and issuance of new shares. This is a routine meeting results filing with no special-situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation is present.
